notes.title: Thales of Miletus Update!
notes.notes:
- Chapter one (Sea of ​​Moisture) now has a teaser level introducing the concepts of velocity and acceleration!
- Chapter Two (Sea of ​​Clouds) now has a teaser level about anti-gravity!
- The hint for level 3.3 has been improved!
- The design of levels 3.13, 6.5 and 6.12 has been improved!

notes.title: Back To School Update!
notes.notes:
You have been heard! Thanks to your feedback, here is a new update of SPACE TOW TRUCK!

In this update :

- level design of levels 3.6, 6.5 and 7.23 was improved
- there is now a smoother transition in PUZZLE MODE after completing a level
- all conversations have been removed in PUZZLE MODE
- there have been several text corrections in english and in french
- other minor bug fixes

notes.title: Post Next Fest Update
notes.notes:
You have been heard!

Thanks to your comments during the Steam Next Fest, a new update of SPACE TOW TRUCK is now available!

Here are some details about this update:

- Sound level of FX reduced (teleportation, time recoil, etc.)
- In the settings, it is now possible to allow (or not) camera shake
- A button now allows you to exit the video replay mode
- A clue has been added to the "demo" level (the one with the black hole)
- When a new page of the instruction manual is available, the "instruction manual" button flashes
- Some other small issues fixed

I am also looking for music to accompany the puzzles. I have browsed the bank of the Pond5.com site, but I have not yet made a choice. If you have any suggestions, please let me know! :)

notes.title: Puzzle Mode Update!
notes.notes:
The puzzle mode is for people who especially like solving puzzles. The narration is greatly reduced and is limited, essentially, to giving information about the mechanics of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37434723/b50472ab396a6e31530ca58b99196ae6744f4c7b.png

In this mode, all levels are accessible from the start and the difficulty level of each level is clearly indicated. The person playing can therefore decide to do the puzzles in any order they wish.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37434723/f9ab8eb2fdf3ff2327c3d6188d3672087a72997f.png

A preview of each level is also available by clicking on the difficulty level.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37434723/ec5c35f24f1b696fd5f58b9e735b069424900827.png
